column1: # Doubletake's Go modules at its go.sum versions, served to its offline build as a file GOPROXY.

# Native assembler for FEX tests; acquired from the official HTTPS release archive.
# Fedora publishes virtio-win unsigned; pin the reviewed release by content.
# Native PDF capture tests use the same Chromium release as the Windows runtime.
# SHA-256 values are published by GitHub release assets for chromium/8057.
# Official mold binaries avoid Fedora's aarch64 mimalloc build, which requires
# ARM LSE atomics unavailable on the Graviton 1 native CI hosts.
